## LoadReason type

Why a load could not read a key: its source failed it, or the load knows the source is not readable for this caller. The other reasons are the run's to give: a load that claimed one (an approval awaited, a deadline) would stop a fallback at a gate nobody can approve. A run reads any other reason an envelope gives as `failed`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type LoadReason = {
    readonly reason: "failed";
} | {
    readonly reason: "unread";
    readonly why: Unread;
    readonly connectors: readonly string[];
};
```
**References:** [Unread](./hopgraph.unread.md)
